verses.original: זְכֹ֤ר יְהוָה֙ מֶֽה־ הָ֣יָה לָ֔נוּ הַבֵּיט וּרְאֵ֥ה אֶת־ חֶרְפָּתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: zə·ḵōr Yah·weh meh- hā·yāh lā·nū hab·bēṭ ū·rə·’êh ’eṯ- ḥer·pā·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: Remember O LORD what has happened to us Look and see - our disgrace

verses.original: נַחֲלָתֵ֙נוּ֙ נֶֽהֶפְכָ֣ה לְזָרִ֔ים בָּתֵּ֖ינוּ לְנָכְרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: na·ḥă·lā·ṯê·nū ne·hep̄·ḵāh lə·zā·rîm bāt·tê·nū lə·nā·ḵə·rîm
verses.literal: Our inheritance has been turned over to strangers our houses to foreigners

verses.original: הָיִ֙ינוּ֙ אֵין אָ֔ב יְתוֹמִ֤ים אִמֹּתֵ֖ינוּ כְּאַלְמָנֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yî·nū ʾēn ’āḇ yə·ṯō·w·mîm ’im·mō·ṯê·nū kə·’al·mā·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: We have become fatherless . . . orphans our mothers are widows

verses.original: בְּכֶ֣סֶף מֵימֵ֙ינוּ֙ שָׁתִ֔ינוּ עֵצֵ֖ינוּ יָבֹֽאוּ׃ בִּמְחִ֥יר
verses.transliteration: bə·ḵe·sep̄ mê·mê·nū šā·ṯî·nū ‘ê·ṣê·nū yā·ḇō·’ū bim·ḥîr
verses.literal: We must buy the water we drink our wood comes at a price

verses.original: עַ֤ל צַוָּארֵ֙נוּ֙ נִרְדָּ֔פְנוּ יָגַ֖עְנוּ לֹא הֽוּנַ֖ח לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al ṣaw·wā·rê·nū nir·dā·p̄ə·nū yā·ḡa‘·nū lō hū·naḥ lā·nū
verses.literal: We are closely . . . pursued we are weary [and find] no rest

verses.original: נָתַ֣נּוּ יָ֔ד מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ אַשּׁ֖וּר לִשְׂבֹּ֥עַֽ לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ṯan·nū yāḏ miṣ·ra·yim ’aš·šūr liś·bō·a‘ lā·ḥem
verses.literal: We submitted . . . to Egypt [and] Assyria to get enough bread

verses.original: אֲבֹתֵ֤ינוּ חָֽטְאוּ֙ אֵינָם אֲנַחְנוּ סָבָֽלְנוּ׃ עֲוֺנֹתֵיהֶ֥ם
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḇō·ṯê·nū ḥā·ṭə·’ū ʾē·nå̄m ʾă·naḥ·nū sā·ḇā·lə·nū ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: Our fathers sinned [and are] no more but we bear their punishment

verses.original: עֲבָדִים֙ מָ֣שְׁלוּ בָ֔נוּ אֵ֥ין פֹּרֵ֖ק מִיָּדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm mā·šə·lū ḇā·nū ’ên pō·rêq mî·yā·ḏām
verses.literal: Slaves rule over us [there is] no one to deliver us from their hands

verses.original: נָבִ֣יא לַחְמֵ֔נוּ בְּנַפְשֵׁ֙נוּ֙ מִפְּנֵ֖י חֶ֥רֶב הַמִּדְבָּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: nā·ḇî laḥ·mê·nū bə·nap̄·šê·nū mip·pə·nê ḥe·reḇ ham·miḏ·bār
verses.literal: We get our bread at the risk of our lives because of the sword in the wilderness

verses.original: עוֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ נִכְמָ֔רוּ כְּתַנּ֣וּר מִפְּנֵ֖י זַלְעֲפ֥וֹת רָעָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·rê·nū niḵ·mā·rū kə·ṯan·nūr mip·pə·nê zal·‘ă·p̄ō·wṯ rā·‘āḇ
verses.literal: Our skin is as hot as an oven with fever from [our] hunger

verses.original: נָשִׁים֙ עִנּ֔וּ בְּצִיּ֣וֹן בְּתֻלֹ֖ת בְּעָרֵ֥י יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: nā·šîm ‘in·nū bə·ṣî·yō·wn bə·ṯu·lōṯ bə·‘ā·rê yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Women have been ravished in Zion virgins in the cities of Judah

verses.original: שָׂרִים֙ נִתְל֔וּ בְּיָדָ֣ם זְקֵנִ֖ים לֹ֥א פְּנֵ֥י נֶהְדָּֽרוּ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·rîm niṯ·lū bə·yā·ḏām zə·qê·nîm lō pə·nê neh·dā·rū
verses.literal: Princes have been hung up by their hands elders receive no respect . . .

verses.original: בַּחוּרִים֙ נָשָׂ֔אוּ טְח֣וֹן וּנְעָרִ֖ים כָּשָֽׁלוּ׃ בָּעֵ֥ץ
verses.transliteration: ba·ḥū·rîm nā·śā·’ū ṭə·ḥō·wn ū·nə·‘ā·rîm kā·šā·lū bā·‘êṣ
verses.literal: Young men toil at millstones boys stagger under loads of wood

verses.original: זְקֵנִים֙ שָׁבָ֔תוּ מִשַּׁ֣עַר בַּחוּרִ֖ים מִנְּגִינָתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: zə·qê·nîm šā·ḇā·ṯū miš·ša·‘ar ba·ḥū·rîm min·nə·ḡî·nā·ṯām
verses.literal: The elders have left the city gate the young men [have stopped] their music

verses.original: מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ שָׁבַת֙ לִבֵּ֔נוּ מְחֹלֵֽנוּ׃ נֶהְפַּ֥ךְ לְאֵ֖בֶל
verses.transliteration: mə·śō·wś šā·ḇaṯ lib·bê·nū mə·ḥō·lê·nū neh·paḵ lə·’ê·ḇel
verses.literal: Joy has left our hearts our dancing has turned to mourning

verses.original: עֲטֶ֣רֶת נָֽפְלָה֙ רֹאשֵׁ֔נוּ אֽוֹי־ נָ֥א לָ֖נוּ כִּ֥י חָטָֽאנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ṭe·reṯ nā·p̄ə·lāh rō·šê·nū ’ō·w- nā lā·nū kî ḥā·ṭā·nū
verses.literal: The crown has fallen from our head Woe . . . to us for we have sinned

verses.original: עַל־ זֶ֗ה לִבֵּ֔נוּ הָיָ֤ה דָוֶה֙ עַל־ אֵ֖לֶּה עֵינֵֽינוּ׃ חָשְׁכ֥וּ
verses.transliteration: ‘al- zeh lib·bê·nū hā·yāh ḏā·weh ‘al- ’êl·leh ‘ê·nê·nū ḥā·šə·ḵū
verses.literal: Because of this our hearts are faint because of these our eyes grow dim

verses.original: עַ֤ל הַר־ צִיּוֹן֙ שֶׁשָּׁמֵ֔ם הִלְּכוּ־ בֽוֹ׃פ שׁוּעָלִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: ‘al har- ṣî·yō·wn šeš·šā·mêm hil·lə·ḵū- ḇōw šū·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: because of Mount Zion which lies desolate patrolled by foxes

verses.original: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ תֵּשֵׁ֔ב לְעוֹלָ֣ם כִּסְאֲךָ֖ לְדֹ֥ר וָדֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ’at·tāh Yah·weh tê·šêḇ lə·‘ō·w·lām kis·’ă·ḵā lə·ḏōr wā·ḏō·wr
verses.literal: You O LORD reign forever Your throne endures from generation to generation

verses.original: לָ֤מָּה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֔נוּ לָנֶ֙צַח֙ תַּֽעַזְבֵ֖נוּ לְאֹ֥רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lām·māh tiš·kā·ḥê·nū lā·ne·ṣaḥ ta·‘az·ḇê·nū lə·’ō·reḵ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Why have You forgotten us forever Why have You forsaken us for so long . . .

verses.original: הֲשִׁיבֵ֨נוּ אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ יְהוָ֤ה׀ וְנָשׁוּב חַדֵּ֥שׁ יָמֵ֖ינוּ כְּקֶֽדֶם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·šî·ḇê·nū ’ê·le·ḵā Yah·weh wə·nå̄·šūḇ ḥad·dêš yā·mê·nū kə·qe·ḏem
verses.literal: Restore us to Yourself O LORD so we may return renew our days as of old

verses.original: כִּ֚י אִם־ מָאֹ֣ס מְאַסְתָּ֔נוּ קָצַ֥פְתָּ עָלֵ֖ינוּ עַד־ מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- mā·’ōs mə·’as·tā·nū qā·ṣap̄·tā ‘ā·lê·nū ‘aḏ- mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: unless . . . You have utterly rejected us . . . and remain angry with us beyond measure . . .
